question.text: For a non-corporate assessee (e.g. LLP) invested in a Cat III AIF, Alternate Minimum Tax (AMT) per the ITA is levied at what rate (on adjusted total income), excluding surcharge/cess?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that, in the case of a non-corporate assessee, AMT is taxable at the rate of 18.5% (15% in the case of a co-operative society) plus applicable surcharge and health and education cess, except where the assessee has exercised the option under Section 115BAC, 115BAD, or 115BAE. The Trap: 15% is the MAT rate for corporates and the AMT rate for co-operative societies. 22% is the concessional corporate rate under Section 115BAA. 30% is the base income-tax rate. Note: AMT credit can be carried forward for up to 15 years and set off against regular tax payable in subsequent years, mirroring the MAT-credit mechanism.
